label: Dungeons & Dragons
tagline: Bend time itself to gather your party.
botPollCreated: A new scroll is unfurled for **{title}**. Run `/availability` or open it here: {url}
botVoteBody: The scroll is sealed and the stars have spoken. Cast your vote below. Times appear in your own timezone.
botVoteClosed: Voting has ended for this scroll.
botPollClosed: The scroll is sealed. The vote will appear in this channel shortly.
botPollDecreed: The session is decreed. Watch this channel for the announcement.
botPollCancelled: This scroll was burned. The {organizer} may unfurl a new one.
botNeedManage: You need the Manage Channels or Manage Server permission to bind a campaign to this channel.
notMember: You are not part of this party yet. In Discord, run /availability in the campaign's channel to join, then reload this page.
notLinked: This campaign is not tied to a Discord channel, so votes and announcements will not be posted there. In the channel, run /chronomancer link with the invite rune:
botNextWeek: Next gathering: unfurl the next scroll for the week of {date}.
frequency: How often does the party gather?
botSessionCancelled: The gathering planned for {when} is cancelled. Await word of a new date.
botRemindersAt: The party will be reminded at: {times}.
botRemindersNoFit: No reminder fits before the session, for it comes sooner than your reminder times. Change them with `/chronomancer reminders`.
